purpose: Reusable fictional identity and continuity control for AOC-001 story media.
boundaries: Do not alter established family relationships, story truth, occupations or locality.
Do not intentionally reproduce a real identifiable person's likeness.
Do not treat invented appearance as representative of Calama or Chile.
Do not introduce unresearched Indigenous or cultural markers.
Reference imagery is fictional production control, never documentary evidence.

family_continuity.hair_family: naturally dark brown with age-appropriate greying
family_continuity.complexion_family: warm medium range with ordinary individual variation
family_continuity.resemblance_method: shared brow line, eye shape, cheek structure and smile shape; never cloned faces
family_continuity.wardrobe_rule: ordinary contemporary practical Calama city life; no luxury or poverty signalling; no unsupported logos

characters.name: Daniela
characters.role: Calama-based administrative worker, partner, mother, daughter of Elena
characters.face: softly angular oval face; defined cheekbones; strong natural brows; deep-brown almond-shaped eyes; medium-width nose; expressive mouth
characters.hair: very dark brown; shoulder length; naturally wavy; loose, half-tied or quickly tied back
wardrobe: casual T-shirt and jeans/trousers at home
behaviour: frequently handling phone, keys, bag or household objects

characters.name: Mauricio
characters.face: broader face; strong natural jaw; deep-brown eyes; straight-to-gently prominent nose; emerging smile lines
characters.hair: dark brown; short practical cut; slight early grey at temples permitted
characters.build: medium-tall; solid practical working build; visibly used hands
wardrobe: generic workwear/high-vis only when context requires

characters.name: Tomás
characters.face: longer adolescent family face; Daniela-like brow and eyes; Mauricio-like developing lower-face structure; deep-brown eyes
characters.hair: thick dark-brown; slightly wavy; longer on top; imperfectly controlled
behaviour: slightly rounded posture over laptop or phone

characters.name: Emilia
characters.face: rounder child version of family features; Daniela/Elena-like eye shape; Mauricio-like smile; deep-brown eyes
characters.hair: dark brown; wavy; around shoulder length; ponytail, loose or imperfectly tied as scene continuity allows
wardrobe: natural brighter colours without branded costume shorthand
behaviour: carries folders, containers or small objects

characters.name: Elena
characters.role: Daniela's mother and the children's grandmother
characters.face: clear Daniela resemblance through eyes, cheekbones and mouth; natural age lines; deep-brown eyes; confident resting expression
characters.hair: dark hair substantially mixed with silver/grey; practical short-to-medium style
characters.build: average height and build; grounded posture

resemblance_map: Daniela and Elena carry the strongest generational resemblance.
Tomás combines Daniela's eye/brow area with more of Mauricio's lower-face structure.
Emilia combines Daniela/Elena eye shape with Mauricio-like smile structure.
Mauricio remains visually distinct enough that the children do not appear cloned from Daniela's side.
